## 7. Limitations of this automated analysis

- The CSV does not document what each column means or its units; this analysis describes structure only and does not interpret undocumented codes or abbreviations.
- Relationships reported here are associations; they do not establish causation.
- The data do not reveal why values are missing, so missing values may not be random and could bias summaries of the affected columns.
- Large shares of exact zeros may represent unrecorded values; if so, means and medians are biased downward.
- The sensitive-data check is a name/pattern heuristic; the absence of a warning does not mean the data are free of personal information.
- Type and role inference are heuristics (thresholds in `config.py`); unusual columns can be misclassified.
- Some checks use random samples (type inference, sensitive patterns, eta squared, scatterplots) with a fixed seed, so results are reproducible but approximate for very large files.
